svg.title: branching.py architecture
svg.desc: Diagram showing the three parts of branching.py: PseudoCostTracker, BranchingStrategy interface, and the five branching strategies including CertaintyFirstBranching
svg.text: answers: "which variable should we branch on next?"

g.text: Stores historical branching effectiveness per variable and direction (0 or 1).
Requires min 3 observations before trusting estimate (reliability gating).
PC(i,0) and PC(i,1) track how useful past branches were.
Every strategy implements select(lp_x, features, graph_state, pseudo_costs).
Branch on the most structurally CERTAIN variable — opposite of classical solvers.

svg.text: STRATEGIES registry lets the solver swap strategies for experiments.
All return: variable index to branch on + preferred direction (0 or 1).
